_meta.title: AMTS Income & Expenditure split — parsed from AMTS annual budget books
_meta.builder: twenty27/sevent4 data agent (AMTS budget-book figures via press + AMC audited B/S)
_meta.scope: AMTS = Ahmedabad Municipal Transport Service, a direct AMC undertaking (municipalised 1947). This file isolates the AMTS undertaking's OWN income vs expenditure (the operating split), which the AMC budget book does NOT carry — the AMC book shows only the single 'Loan to AMTS' support line (see amc_civic_lines.json). Companion: AJL/BRTS is a separate SPV (MCA CIN U60231GJ2007SGC052023).
_meta.units: amount_cr = Rupees crore. Figures are AMTS budget-estimate (BE) unless noted.
_meta.tiers: [NEWS] = press report of the AMTS budget; [AUDITED] = AMC audited balance sheet; [DERIVED] = arithmetic from reported components. The fuel/diesel-CNG/GCC line-item split is NOT in press summaries — pull the AMTS budget book PDF for it (HITL).
_meta.caveats: Self-reported BE figures from the implementer; treat as direction + magnitude, not audited actuals. Farebox-from-tickets is derived (income_total minus named subsidies) where not separately reported.

amts_income_expenditure.amc_loan_basis: AMC extended a loan of Rs 410 cr to AMTS in 2024-25

amts_income_expenditure.fleet_additions: 445 new AC buses (incl 100 AC-CNG) + 4 electric double-deckers; new terminals Saraspur + Meghani Nagar
amts_income_expenditure.fare_concessions: 50% widows; 85% off female students (post Class-10); free passes orphan students (post Class-10); BRTS+Metro ticket integration
amts_income_expenditure.source: Gujarat Samachar (Rs 682 cr draft; debt Rs 4620.77 cr); Knocksense (Rs 705 cr approved; concessions; fleet)

amts_income_expenditure.electrification_target: ALL AMTS buses electric AND air-conditioned by 2030 (AMTS's OWN stated target)
amts_income_expenditure.source: DeshGujarat 2026-01-29 (Rs 991 cr budget; fully-electric-AC-by-2030); Gujarat Samachar (debt Rs 5,092 cr)

audited_cumulative_cross_check.amts_audit_note: AMTS is not generating revenue surplus from its operations; no impairment provision (effectively permanent subsidy)
audited_cumulative_cross_check.source: AMC Finance Dept Audited Balance Sheet as on 31-03-2024 (filed with NSE; copy in twenty27 data/external/ahmedabad-transit/AMC-audited-balance-sheet-2023-24.pdf)

readings: Income (~Rs 238 cr 2025-26 / Rs 358 cr 2026-27) is dwarfed by salary+pension alone (~Rs 347-348 cr) — staff/pension is the single biggest cost, and even that exceeds total income. The undertaking cannot run on its own receipts.
AMTS survives on AMC deficit-loans (Rs 410 -> 437 -> 600 cr) it is never expected to repay (audited: no impairment provision). Accumulated debt Rs 4,620 -> 5,092 cr.
The farebox proper (~Rs 78-93 cr) is a small slice; the fare is a barrier, not a funding source — the case for free fares.
AMTS's OWN 2026-27 budget commits to a fully electric + AC fleet by 2030 — the Mevani plank is the city's own stated target, done on time, at frozen/zero fares, and route-transparent.
